text: Tellia is an agtech company that offers voice assisted operating software for farmers and agronomic advisers. Tellia has raised $3.0M in total funding. The most recent round was Seed. The last funding was announced in January 2026. Tellia is headquartered in Dover, United States. Tellia is at the Seed stage. Free to use in articles, research, and reference works.
